title: Tricky (high-frequency) words
examples: Teacher, what makes these words tricky?
Can we practice reading these words quickly?
Do I need to sound out the word 'said'?

explain.say: Today we learn some tricky words. These words do not follow normal sounds. Say the word the.
The word the is very common. We just need to see it and know it. Say the word said.
The word was is also tricky for us. We practice seeing it many times. Say the word was.
These words are called sight words. You learn them by seeing them often. We practice reading them quickly now.

faq.q: Why are these words called tricky words?
faq.a: They are tricky because their sounds do not match what the letters look like. It is easier just to remember them by sight. (asks) What are sight words? (asks) Why can't I sound out 'the'?

faq.q: Do I have to sound out every word?
faq.a: No, for these special words, we just look and say them right away. We learn to read them instantly. (asks) Should I sound out 'was'?
asks: Do I always sound out words?

faq.q: How many tricky words should I learn?
faq.a: You learn them slowly, one small group at a time. Practice makes these words feel easy to read. (asks) Is this for forever?
asks: How many tricky words should I learn?
Will I learn all of them?

faq.q: Can I use these words in my writing?
faq.a: Yes, you use them all the time when you write sentences. They help your stories sound more natural. (asks) Are these words for reading only?
asks: Are these words for reading only?
Can I use these words in my writing?

faq.q: What is the difference between a tricky word and a normal word?
faq.a: A normal word follows the sounds we learn in phonics. A tricky word is one we just have to memorize by seeing it. (asks) Is 'the' a normal word?
asks: How is it different from other words?

facts: Sight words are words that appear very often in writing.
Learning them by sight helps reading become faster.
These words do not always follow standard phonics rules.
Practicing them helps build reading fluency.

quiz.say: Which word do you see most often in stories?
quiz.why: The word 'the' is one of the most common words in English.

wrong.0: This is wrong because 'the' is the specific word we are focusing on.
wrong.2: This is a common mistake because it is also a tricky word.
wrong.3: This is tempting because it is also a high-frequency word.

quiz.say: If I see 'said' many times, what should I do?
quiz.why: Because it is a sight word, you should read it quickly without sounding it out.

wrong.0: Writing it helps, but reading it quickly is the main goal.
wrong.1: You must read all the words to understand the story.
wrong.3: This is tempting because you learn to sound out words usually.

quiz.say: What do you do when you see the word 'was'?

options.show: Ask a grown-up to read it
options.say: Ask a grown-up to read it

options.show: Treat it like a consonant blend
options.say: Treat it like a consonant blend

quiz.why: Recognizing it instantly means you know it right away without thinking too hard.

wrong.0: This is a common mistake because it is easy to try and sound it out.
wrong.1: You are learning to read it yourself now.
wrong.2: This is wrong because it is a whole word, not just letters together.
